info.title: tansr-api
info.description: tansr 统一 API:数据面(模型网关,SSE)+ 控制面(认证/配置/用量/余额/会话)+ 管理面(门户 BFF 专用)。契约 tag: api-contract-v0。

tags.name: gateway
tags.description: 数据面(openai/anthropic 兼容,维护态):上游协议 passthrough,响应头 x-tansr-cost / x-tansr-balance / x-tansr-request-id / x-tansr-price-table

tags.name: twp
tags.description: TANSR 自有协议 twp/1 末端面(T-A13,doc/28 §4):AK/SK 认证(x-tansr-key-id + x-tansr-key),无匿名面;exchange 流式 SSE 事件语法(t.*)不进 OpenAPI,单源 = src/contract/twp.ts + doc/28 §4.4

tags.name: orgs
tags.description: 企业面(T-A9):org 生命周期/成员/邀请/SSO;org 作用域经 x-tansr-org 头声明

tags.name: org-governance
tags.description: 组织资源管理面(P-S11,doc/32):治理设置/审批/直配/许可/委托/预算/归因。O-A0 契约冻结:形状恒定,路由随 O-A3..O-A5 落地(未落地期间 404);治理写权须 JWT 人类主体,org PAT 恒 403 principal_required;跨 org 探针恒同形 404

tags.name: apps
tags.description: 应用管理面(T-A13):App = ApiKeyId 账套;密文仅创建/轮换一次性回显

tags.name: admin
tags.description: 门户 BFF 专用,x-tansr-admin-key 服务间凭据

tags.name: webhooks
tags.description: 支付渠道回调(验签 + 幂等)

get.summary: 存活探针(liveness):进程活着即 200 常量,体 {ok:true, version(package.json), db:ok|down|not-configured}(db 只如实报,不改状态码);compose healthcheck 看本端点,水位判据归 /readyz

就绪探针(readiness;部署脚本以本端点判就绪):{ version(package.json), gitSha(env TANSR_API_GIT_SHA ← Dockerfile ARG GIT_SHA;缺席 null), schemaRevision(末已应用迁移文件名去后缀,如 081_catalog_anchor_realign;零应用 null), schemaCurrent(迁移目录全部 done 且无半迁移;mysql 不可达 null = 未知), deps:{ mysql:ok|degraded, redis:ok|degraded } };**仅 schemaCurrent === false ⇒ 503**(schema 落后于代码 = 半态不接流量),deps 降级只如实报不改状态码

503.description: 未就绪:schemaCurrent === false(留有未应用 / 半迁移)

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: 请求层幂等键(可选,加法):同键同载荷——completed 返缓存结果(携 x-tansr-idempotent-replay: 1;SSE 结果不可重放恒 409)/ 飞行中 202 in_progress / 失败可同键重试;同键异载荷恒 409 idempotency_conflict;成功交换上游调用恒 1 次、计费恒 1 次

200.description: 上游响应透传(JSON 或 text/event-stream);幂等缓存重放时携 x-tansr-idempotent-replay: 1(体/计费头 = 完成时刻快照)

400.description: content_blocked(T-A15 安全审查:入向预扣前拦截零计费/非流出向不下发;detail.reason)/ egress_blocked(T-A24 出网零信任:上游目标命中私网/元数据/回环或非 HTTPS,detail.reason)/ bad_request(idempotency-key 坏形)

409.description: idempotency_conflict(T-A23:同幂等键异载荷;或已完成结果不可重放(SSE/超限,detail.replayable=false);或 requestId 已达计费层不再重飞)

429.description: rate_limited(携 Retry-After)/ quota_exceeded(T-A17 策略包日 token 上限,UTC+8 日界;T-A23 起计数在占位阶段原子预留,结算差额校正;T-A29 起 compat JWT/PAT 径按 owner 级桶计数判限——多 PAT 不倍增配额)

Sdk2CacheSequence.description: Canonical unsigned decimal 0..2^63-1. Never parse through IEEE754 Number.

Sdk2CacheEpochView.$comment: Trusted host initialization/independent rotator durably prepares current epoch. GET reads snapshot and never mints/renews one. No current live epoch => epoch_unavailable for admission. Rotation disables old write admission, never hides already admitted operation status; retired/unknown IDs cannot be recreated from requests. S1 epoch lifetime defaults to 3600000ms, hard maximum 86400000ms; trusted host validates 0<expiresAt-issuedAt<=effective epochLifetimeMs. Terminal receipt cannot be collected before BOTH epoch expiry and terminal retention expiry; unresolved operations remain. An active epoch is never a license to recreate a collected request ID.

Sdk2CacheLegacyId.description: Existing opaque ID; no trimming, case folding or Unicode normalization. Do not mint authority from this string.

Sdk2CacheTicket.$comment: 32 random bytes, canonical base64url without padding. Scope/audience-bound reference, not self-asserted authority; never log or use as provider key.

Sdk2CacheRebindRequest.$comment: Current owner authentication plus trusted persisted session/logical lineage, not a bare claimed sessionId; may replace expired/rotated device ticket only while mapping and binding remain active and current policy/deletion witnesses match. No resurrection of revoked/closed/expired mapping.

Sdk2CacheMutationReceipt.$comment: Immutable original result, not current authorization or current binding state. Atomic mapping/ticket/revision/receipt commit. Replay under current authority precedes fresh epoch/CAS; never renew TTL on replay.

Sdk2CacheExchangeMetadata.$comment: Gateway route only: 4-byte big-endian metadata length + canonical metadata <=64KiB + unchanged original TWP UTF-8 body <=32MiB. SHA is raw transport integrity, never a diagnostic fingerprint. Existing TWP body schema and original auth/signature/idempotency/usage remain required; new operation semantic identity additionally binds this immutable envelope. Never decode/reencode inner bytes for retry.

Sdk2CacheExchangeFrame.description: 原始字节帧：4 字节无符号大端整数指定 metadata 的 UTF-8 字节数，后接严格 JSON metadata，再接未经改写的原 TWP JSON 字节。metadata 最多 65536 字节；TWP 为 1..33554432 字节。长度、SHA-256 和 runtimeSessionId 必须与实际 TWP 相符。

RuntimeContinuityGrant.description: 凭据解码形；只能由核验真实Store租约、当前授权和删除状态且耐久固定原intent后的可信后端签署。JSON规范字节最多16384，有效窗至多300000ms，时钟领先至多30000ms。HMAC-SHA256域为tansr.sdk2.runtime-continuity.grant.v1加NUL，再拼去signature后的encodeCacheControl规范字节。只授予完整固定intent的execute/lookup；不向终端下发issuer密钥。

body.description: UTF-8编码后不得超过262144字节；仅原完整JSON结果。
